name: Light Grid Resolution
definition: Specifies resolution of light grid as percentage of fire grid's resolution. Perfect illumination requires light in each fire cell, but is slow. A separate light grid with lower resolution is created internally, populated with one Omni light per cell. Lower resolution (fewer lights) speeds up rendering at expense of illumination detail. At 100, light grid has same resolution as fire grid. Smaller resolution yields smoother illumination and faster rendering. Very low values may cause poor blending between fire and light on smoke.
summary: Light Grid Resolution approximates fire self-illumination by placing discrete Omni lights in a downscaled grid, differing from other methods by operating at the light source generation stage rather than during texture remapping.
